The competency cases

Tier S means a source documents a real situation — 5 of 20. Tier A is constructed and says so — 15.

Decision situationHeuristicTier
A new engineer is told 'the model is bad' and has to decide where to even look.Sort by swappability: if fixing it would need a different model it is L1, otherwise it is L2.A
Three findings land in a postmortem and each must be attributed before anyone is assigned work.Before crediting a model action, ask what the model was shown; the harness owns what it saw.A
DeepSeek had to ship a way for developers to benchmark MODELS when every harness capability they add moves the score. They shipped Minimal mode: a two-tool agent, persistent bash plus str_replace_editor, and nothing else.To measure one layer, hold the other at its thinnest and keep it constant.S
NVIDIA ran the same models across different harnesses on SWE-bench Verified and had to report what the harness alone was worth.A model-versus-model claim is uninterpretable unless the harness was held constant across the comparison.S
One week, one engineer, scores below target, and a choice between the model and the harness.Spend on the variable you own and can change this week; name the expectancy that would prove you wrong before you spend.A
A trace schema is being designed and someone asks which model field to store.Record the value that VARIES with the thing you want to detect, not the one you chose.A
Quality drops 8% with no release, and the team has to decide what to investigate.When an outcome moves and nothing you shipped moved, look for a cause OUTSIDE your change surface.A
Someone files 'add an alert for model changes' and it has to be accepted or refused.Check that the field can move before building a detector on it.A
An eval jumps 28 points overnight and a decision must be made about whether to believe it.Check the denominator before the numerator; a population change is cheaper to make and easier to miss.A
A nightly rubric pages someone at 8am and the team argues about whether quality is 'gated'.Classify a control by POSITION relative to the ship, not by its content.A
A bill triples and someone proposes raising the timeout.Match the bound's scope to the resource's scope: per-call bounds cannot bound a whole run.A
A 90-second timeout is in place, has never fired, and spend has tripled.Ask which state the existing control ends, then ask whether that is the state you are in.A
A runaway hits 190 turns and a cap has to be chosen in the postmortem.Size a bound from the healthy distribution, never from the incident that prompted it.A
A model swap lands and nobody revisits the turn cap.Re-derive a proxy bound whenever the proxy-to-resource ratio can move, or denominate it in the resource.A
A production system let a query return however many rows the database chose to give it. The result set grew with the data, and the team's own DBA eventually found it topping the list of most expensive queries — the failure only became visible at scale, long after the code was correct-looking.Whoever benefits from the answer must not own the bound on it.S
Anthropic ran a coding agent across many context windows to build a claude.ai clone. A later agent instance in the sequence looked around, saw that progress had been made, and declared the project finished — while most of the feature set did not exist.When a run ends early, reach for a completion predicate, not a tighter bound.S
The same team had to stop agents marking features complete without testing them. They expanded one prompt into over 200 end-to-end features in a JSON file, all initially marked failing, and instructed agents that they may change only the passes field — 'It is unacceptable to remove or edit tests.'A constraint on a party must not be editable by that party.S
A large framework-swap PR arrives with tests passing and two approvals.Ask which controls were registered with the thing being replaced.A
03:00 page. Spend 40x, latency normal, no deploy in six days.Bound the loss before diagnosing it, when the bound is reversible and cheap.A
Someone gives a confident answer in review and it has to be judged as competent or merely assured.Look for the named cue and the falsifying expectancy, not for confidence.A

Where the claims come from

9 supported by a source · 8 transferred by analogy · 3 the packet's own claim, marked as such.

SourceReadWhy this one
Six Agent Harness Capabilities for Higher Model Performance (NVIDIA Labs Object-Oriented Agents, NOOA) — link2026-08-26it runs the controlled experiment: the model is held fixed and the harness is varied, and the swing is reported in both score and token cost. Every other source here asserts that the harness matters; this one measures how much.
DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — developer preview site and developer documentation — link2026-08-26it is the only source that ENUMERATES the harness rather than describing it: models, tools, skills, sessions, sandboxes, storage, loops, scheduling and the UI are named as separately swappable plugins, so 'what is the runtime' has a checkable answer instead of a metaphor
Effective harnesses for long-running agents — link2026-08-26it reports the failure that runs OPPOSITE to the one everyone expects. The agent does not run away; it looks around, sees progress, and declares the job done. A source that inverts the reader's prior earns its place ahead of one that confirms it.
Building effective agents — link2026-08-26it draws the boundary that the whole L1/L2 distinction rests on — predefined code paths versus the model directing its own process — and it is the boundary the other three sources each redraw differently
Release It! — Stability Antipatterns and Stability Patterns (Timeouts, Circuit Breaker, Bulkheads, Fail Fast)2026-08-26it is the only source here that treats termination as a PROPERTY OF THE CALLER, arrived at from production incidents rather than from agent design, which is what lets the packet ask whether an agent loop is a new problem or an old one wearing new words

How to run it

Open a Claude Code session on this directory, then:

learn agent-harness-l1-l2teaches a chunk, then asks
drill measks from the bank, grades against a frozen ideal
/icp-advisoranswers as ICP1 and ICP2, and names the inversion
node progress-store.mjsthe learning curve, or UNEVALUABLE with a reason

Ideals are deliberately not published here — printing the answer key turns every later attempt from recall into recognition.
